title: Bram and the Harvest
author: Yara Vasquez
blurb: Rafael Kavanagh, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
